raw_http_text: {"id":"8449d0db-1e2e-45a8-8dd6-3f180ab57b0a_2srn76g3z7oqt9dpmo_46a1288c14c94481991edbc21a54eced","choices":[{"finish_reason":"stop","index":0,"message":{"content":"{\"schema_version\":\"1.0\",\"packet_id\":\"CAND_TOPIC_03_R2_V1\",\"mode\":\"organized_reflection\",\"sentences\":[{\"text\":\"预警信息有时效性，网站不保留过期信息以免混淆，核查时应确认原发布时间与适用时段。\",\"citations\":[\"WE_E04\"],\"kind\":\"paraphrase\"},{\"text\":\"中央气象台主要发布渠道是官网和国家突发事件预警信息发布网，仅凭截图不能替代原始来源核对。\",\"citations\":[\"WE_E05\"],\"kind\":\"paraphrase\"},{\"text\":\"集合预报科普指出初始状态与真实大气存在误差，但未核验具体预报，也未提供长期准确率检验结果。\",\"citations\":[\"WE_E06\"],\"kind\":\"limitation\"},{\"text\":\"在初始误差存在且未提供长期准确率检验的条件下，依据有效预报作风险准备时应如何界定其适用时段？\",\"citations\":[\"WE_E06\"],\"kind\":\"question\"}]}","role":"assistant","tool_calls":null}}],"created":1794399685,"model":"mimo-v2.6-flash","object":"chat.completion","usage":{"completion_tokens":204,"prompt_tokens":1780,"total_tokens":1984,"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":0},"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":512}}}
